newsitem.title: UK: London precious metals close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: London precious metals close narrowly mixed.

text.p: GOLD - Closed at $369.30/$369.80 vs $368.80/$369.10 on Tuesday. Very quiet re-start to trading post Christmas holiday. Seen remaining in narrow range until early January.
SILVER - Crept higher to finish at $4.90/$4.92, up six cents.
PLATINUM - Always under mild pressure mainly from light short selling. Finished down $3.25 at $368.75/$369.75.
